items.headline: College Football Playoff 2026: Bubble Watch after Week 3
items.description: Putting the spotlight on select teams and questions around others as the early playoff picture takes shape.

items.headline: Ranking college football's 35 unbeaten teams after Week 3
items.description: Following Week 3, Bill Connelly takes stock of which undefeated teams he trusts and which are pretenders.

items.headline: No. 5 Indiana begins defense of Big Ten championship against improved and unbeaten Northwestern
items.description: The Indiana Hoosiers spent Curt Cignetti's first two seasons rebranding the program.

items.headline: Aidan Chiles throws to Joseph Himon II for 3 TDs, runs in 2, Northwestern routs Colorado 41-7
items.description: — Aidan Chiles passed to Joseph Himon II for three touchdowns and ran in two himself to lead Northwestern to a 41-7 rout of Colorado on Saturday night.

items.headline: How coaches returning to their former stomping grounds have fared
items.description: Lane Kiffin's long-awaited return to Oxford comes Saturday. It's not the first time a big-name coach -- or Kiffin himself -- has returned to a vengeful campus.

items.headline: Northwestern extends coach David Braun through 2031
items.description: Northwestern coach David Braun has agreed to a new contract through the 2031 season, extending his agreement by three years.
